workflow: Review and lock individual high-resolution assets before applying them to the live page.

assets.name: Production Header Panorama — Reworked
assets.notes: Reworked panorama with stronger integrated upper branches and foliage. Replaces the earlier panorama and makes Asset 17 unnecessary.

assets.name: Thin Transparent Outer Frame
assets.notes: Dark carved oak, restrained antique-gold trim, sparse ivy, and a small right-side lantern; first accepted version.

assets.name: Main Council Notes Parchment
assets.notes: Large text-free front-facing parchment with worn edges, subtle fibers, restrained corner engraving, and a clean writing area.

assets.name: Shallow Carved Section Header
assets.notes: Blank horizontal carved section-header bar with antique-gold crest and the accepted ivy density.

assets.name: Reusable Wood Panel Body
assets.notes: Layout-fit rectangular dark-oak panel body with an open center for live module content.

assets.name: Bottom Navigation Beam
assets.notes: Five equal blank bays; deterministic SVG/PNG construction.

assets.name: Hanging Crest Banner
assets.notes: Forest-green hanging banner with gold tree crest.

assets.name: Header Stat Plaque
assets.notes: Blank parchment stat plaque; accepted with the small pointed lower edge.

assets.name: Heraldic Shield Crest
assets.notes: Forest-green and antique-gold tree shield.

assets.name: Crimson Wax Seal
assets.notes: Deep-red hand-pressed seal with recessed gold tree stamp.

assets.name: Council Message Strip
assets.notes: Wide blank parchment strip for live text, timestamps, shields, and seals.

assets.name: Council Input Bar
assets.notes: Slim parchment input field; tiny center accent intentionally retained.

assets.name: Subtitle Scroll Ribbon
assets.notes: Rolled outward ends and blank center for live subtitle text.

assets.name: Vertical Utility Panel
assets.notes: Dark-oak and antique-gold panel with three control bays.

assets.name: Wall Lantern
assets.notes: Compact antique-brass wall lantern with shorter bracket and amber glow.

assets.name: Vertical Vine Overlay
assets.notes: Narrow mirrorable edge vine; sparse leaves, bark, tendrils, and muted berries.

assets.name: Top Canopy Overlay
assets.notes: Retired after canopy framing was integrated directly into reworked Asset 1. Historical files are preserved under 02_retired_assets and must not be integrated.

assets.name: Side Parchment Family v2
assets.notes: Locked for now as shallow, medium, and deep fixed-ratio variants with reduced corner intrusion and enlarged safe areas.

assets.name: Tall Battle Report Parchment
assets.notes: Native tall single-panel generation; replaces the visibly stretched attempt.

assets.name: Section Header Beam v3
assets.notes: Locked for now. Reference-traced slim near-black wood header with thin tarnished-gold rules and no baked title, icon, or control state.

assets.name: Compact Status / Readout Panel
assets.notes: Blank compact dark-oak readout panel for the Current Read module; transparent exterior and no baked text or emblem.

assets.name: Transparent Ledger / Stat Row Overlay
assets.notes: Retired. Use documented live CSS row separators instead of PNG/SVG overlays.

assets.name: Compact Utility / Action Button Frame
assets.notes: Deterministic 10:7 dark-oak utility tile with transparent exterior and no baked content.

assets.name: Utility Action Icon Set
assets.notes: Three antique-gold default-state icons for Chamber, Themes, and Hide/Show. No baked labels or interaction states.

assets.name: Bottom Navigation Supplemental Icon Set
assets.notes: Three antique-gold navigation icons: Council Notes scroll, Closed Ledgers book, and Battle Reports crossed swords. Asset 24 scales and gear remain reused.

assets.name: Generic Micro-Control Button Frame
assets.notes: Reusable circular dark-oak and antique-gold frame for small live controls. The center remains blank for SVG glyph overlays.

assets.name: Micro-Control Glyph Set
assets.notes: Transparent antique-gold Help, Add, Collapse, Expand, and Menu glyphs for use inside Asset 26.

assets.name: Minimal Comparison Meter v2
assets.notes: Locked. Minimal frame matching original Battle Report; fills, colors, labels, values, and percentages remain live.

legacy_archive_note: 99_legacy_archive contains the earlier low-resolution pack for recovery only. Do not treat it as the current production set.
correction_note: Assets 01-05 were accidentally omitted from the first handoff ZIP and restored in this corrected package.
